card.summary: The PBM Price Transparency and Accountability Act amends titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to regulate pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and improve pricing transparency in Medicare Part D and Medicaid. It requires transparent pass-through pricing models in Medicaid, prohibits certain forms of spread pricing, establishes pharmacy survey reporting requirements to determine actual acquisition costs, creates new accountability and reporting rules for PBMs operating in Medicare, ensures any willing pharmacy can join Medicare prescription drug plan networks under reasonable contract terms, and provides funding for government studies and oversight.

card.summary: The Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act of 2025 amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to authorize targeted clinical trials using combinations of drugs for pediatric cancer. It also renews the Food and Drug Administration's authority to issue priority review vouchers for sponsors of new products intended to treat rare pediatric diseases until September 30, 2030, and requires the Government Accountability Office and the Department of Health and Human Services to submit reports on the implementation and effectiveness of these provisions.
